fit: train 2019-2023 REG, nflverse player_stats aggregated to team-game; test 2024-2026
inputs: this season's player game log (prior weeks only) + game spread/total; no pbp features

feature_definitions.base_rr: (team sum Rush Att over prior games this season + 300*0.4384) / (team sum (Rush Att + Pass Att) over prior games + 300); Rush Att and Pass Att summed over all the team's player rows
feature_definitions.base_rb_car: (team sum Rush Att of Pos=RB rows over prior games + 8*21.6676) / (prior games played + 8)
feature_definitions.own_ypc: (team sum Rush Yds prior games + 150*4.3429) / (team sum Rush Att prior games + 150)
feature_definitions.opp_ypc_allowed: (sum Rush Yds by all teams vs this opponent in opponent's prior games + 150*4.3429) / (their Rush Att + 150)
feature_definitions.opp_pass_yds_allowed_pg: (sum Pass Yds by teams vs this opponent in opponent's prior games + 3*244.01) / (opponent prior games + 3)
feature_definitions.imp_margin: team implied margin = -(team's FanDuel spread); e.g. team -4.5 -> +4.5

notes: Rush Att in history = nflverse player_stats carries (includes QB scrambles and kneels); Pass Att = attempts (excludes sacks); Pass Yds = gross passing yards. Production game log should match these conventions.
Week 1 (no prior games): every season-to-date feature equals its league constant.
Opponent features use the opponent's own prior games this season (what offenses gained against them).
Lines in the fit are nflverse closing spread_line/total_line, used as a stand-in for FanDuel.
Rush-rate target is the player-row rate sum(Rush Att)/(sum(Rush Att)+sum(Pass Att)) for the game.
